name: tnca-sim-2x2
description: Four tiles in a 2x2 mesh, two Role Contexts per core, four NUCA slices, DRAM behind them. What tb/top/tb_tnca_top.v elaborates.
note: Generated file -- do not edit. Run `make target`. Derived from rtl/core/tnca_core.v, rtl/tnca_top.v and isa/tnca-isa-v0.1.json; see compiler_overview.md sec 15 C0.

dma.note: A window names vector registers and nothing else (ISA sec 9D.2); it is not a scratchpad and has no byte pointer, so a transfer target must be a register range.

issue.note: Single issue; sec 10.4 accumulates cost per shared unit.

nuca.note: home = H(physical line address); no replication and no migration, so there is no inter-slice coherence protocol to model.

scalar.note: SALU is integer only; move uniform FP through the vector domain or carry it as a bit pattern.

design_fact_sources.tensor_max_rank: rtl/core/tnca_core.v TNCA_SPEC_MAX_RANK; the transfer engine implements rank 1-2 only
design_fact_sources.mma_shape: ISA sec 9C: m.mma.async is a 16x16x16 step
design_fact_sources.mma_accum_order: ISA sec 9C.1: RNE_f32(exact(A)*exact(B) + C), increasing k, bit-reproducible
design_fact_sources.gather_index_scaling: ISA sec 9.1: lane i => Sa + sext(Vb[i]) * sz
design_fact_sources.descriptor_semantic_bytes: ISA sec 9D.3: bytes 0-127 are semantics, 128-255 are ignorable hints
